business_summary: Namkwang Engineering & Construction Co., Ltd. provides various construction services in Korea and internationally. The company constructs apartments, commercial/business facilities, public/leisure facilities, factories/plants, and culture/history/other projects; and roads, bridges/tunnels, subways/railroads, water/sewerage works, and harbors/dams/ ports. Namkwang Engineering & Construction Co., Ltd. was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Yongin-si, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 남광건설(주)는 국내외 다양한 건설 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. 아파트, 상업/업무시설, 공공/휴양시설, 공장/플랜트, 문화/역사/기타 사업 등을 건설하는 회사입니다. 도로, 교량/터널, 지하철/철도, 상하수도, 항만/댐/항구 등이 있습니다. 남광건설주식회사는 1947년에 설립되었으며 대한민국 용인시에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
